name: luna-worker-planner
description: Plan and govern projects while luna_worker maintains compact project-root context and the planner critically evaluates results.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, and critically evaluate results.
interface.longDescription: Use this conversation as the project planner and controller. For repository code work, luna_worker creates and maintains a compact .luna-worker-context.md at the project root. Later self-contained workers read it first to avoid repeated repository discovery, while the planner critically reviews their final reports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Luna Worker Planner to have luna_worker maintain project-root context, require later workers to read it first, critically review their reports, and make independent planning decisions.
